FIRST AMENDMENT
to Maintenance Services Agreement
by and between
Naveed Shah ("First Party") and Zameen Developments (Private) Limited ("Second
Party")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This first amendment ("First Amendment") to the Maintenance Services Agreement dated gth
January, 2021 ("Maintenance Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 28th
October, 2025.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Maintenance Agreement for management of an area
measuring seventy-five hundred (7500) sq. ft, on ground floor of the building named and
styled as "Mega Tower", located at 63-B, Main Boulevard, Gulberg II, Lahore ("Demised
Premises"); and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Maintenance Agreement as
per the terms and conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall come into force on 1st January, 2024 ("Effective Date").

2.

Pursuant to Clause 2.1 of the Maintenance Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree
to extend the term of the Maintenance Agreement for a period of four (4) years,
commencing from the Effective Date and ending on 31st December, 2027 ("Extended
Term").

3.

With effect from 1st January 2025:
3.1. the Second Party shall charge to the First Party, an amount of Rs. 4 (Rupees Four)
per square feet, exclusive of all taxes, for the water and sewerage services.
3.2. The First Party, for the uninterrupted supply of electricity through generators, shall
maintain two separate meters along with ATS Panel and shall charge the Second
Party for the use of generator a rate of Rs. 80 (Rupees Seventy) per unit utilized,
exclusive of all taxes, where one unit is equal to one KWH (the 'Generator
Charges"). The Generator Charges shall be paid by the Second Party in arrears
within fifteen (30) days of the date of receipt of invoice issued by the First Party. In
addition to above, the Second Party shall also charge Rs. 7500 (Rupees SeventyFive Hundred) fixed line rent, exclusive of all taxes, for use of Genset.

4.

All other terms and provisions in the Maintenance Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply
and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein
.-..-

First Party's Initials:

Second Party's initials:

c

In the event of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any
conflicting term in the Maintenance Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.
5.

This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Maintenance Agreement.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Maintenance Agreement shall bear the
same meaning in this First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
